blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS—Eight cities and municipalities in Bulacan will experience water service interruptions from Tuesday (Oct. 12) to Wednesday (Oct. 13) due to a system shutdown by the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS). The Provincial Government of Bulacan on Monday advised the towns of Balagtas, Bulakan, Plaridel, Marilao, Sta. Maria and the cities of Malolos, Meycauayan and San Jose del Monte, which rely on the Bulacan Bulk Water System Project (BBWSP), about the water service interruption It said MWSS would close Aqueduct No. 6 to facilitate alignment work on Aqueduct No. 7.
